name: x-api-mcp
description: Post, reply, thread, upload media and manage multiple X (Twitter) accounts through the official X API. Runs locally; tokens stay on your machine.

X_CLIENT_ID.title: X Client ID
X_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID of your own X App (console.x.com). Can be left empty and set later with the set_client_id tool.

X_CLIENT_SECRET.title: X Client Secret
X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Only for Web App (confidential) clients. Leave empty for a Native App.

X_TOOLS.title: Tools to enable
X_TOOLS.description: all: read and write tools. write: only posting and other write tools (reads cost money).

X_AUTH_MODE.title: Authorization mode
X_AUTH_MODE.description: auto detects; loopback saves the callback automatically when the browser is on this computer; paste asks you to paste the callback URL.

X_REQUIRE_ACCOUNT.title: Require an explicit account for writes
X_REQUIRE_ACCOUNT.description: 1 refuses write calls that do not name the account, to avoid posting from the wrong account. 0 falls back to the default account.

X_ENABLE_DM.title: Enable direct messages
X_ENABLE_DM.description: 1 requests DM scopes and adds DM tools. Turn on only if your X App has Direct Messages permission.
